global_weighting.weight_basis: Single ACWI ETF equity-sleeve USD market values; indicative large/mid-cap global proxy, not issuer market capitalizations

quality.acwi_reference_method: ACWI equity holding values (USD), not fund size or sum of unrelated ETF allocations
quality.warning: ETF holdings are a sampled investable proxy, not the total worldwide listed-equity universe. Country tiers are ETF allocation ranks, not issuer market-cap segments.

methodology.world: Holdings mapped from IWB, IWM, IWV, IEFA, EWC, IEMG. ACWI is an optional global *weighting anchor* only, not added as duplicate securities. ACWI large/mid-cap exposure is not a full all-cap global market census.
methodology.classification: Developed versus emerging uses the ETF/MSCI mandates; geographic region is a display grouping. Classification can differ from FTSE Russell.
methodology.country: Countries use holdings Location; not country of revenue, listing or issuer domicile necessarily.
methodology.size: Country holding tiers are rank percentiles of allocation within one ETF and one country, NOT issuer market-cap classifications. worldWeight uses a single global ETF proxy and is not verified issuer capitalization. Galaxy radius is a visual square-root scale with legibility floors.
methodology.weights: worldWeight uses one ACWI ETF equity-sleeve USD market-value denominator; deeper nodes allocate that share using their local source ETF weights, not issuer free-float market capitalizations. Other weight remains ETF-local; null means unknown.
methodology.sector: Sector reported by iShares holdings, not necessarily full current GICS industry hierarchy.
methodology.industry: Optional Yahoo industry (not official GICS subindustry) or issuer-provided industry; unclassified names retained.
methodology.returns: ETF adjusted-close returns where Yahoo Finance data succeeds; not individual-stock returns.
methodology.coverage: Broad but incomplete global coverage. Some frontier markets and uninvestable/micro-cap listings excluded; Yahoo access may be rate limited.
